## RESULT

**Each additional ongoing medical condition (MHONGO) is independently associated with a 32.7% increase in the odds of higher COVID-19 severity (95% CI 15.1%–53.0%; p=0.0001), controlling for BCG vaccination status, work_hours, patients_seen, and expect_interact — from a proportional-odds cumulative-logit ordinal regression (n=1000).**

Details (primary specification):
- Outcome: per-patient COVID-19 severity = worst AESEV grade across **COVID-19 AE rows only** (AEPT containing "COVID"), levels 0–4 with 0 = no COVID-19 AE with a scored grade. Counts: 0:849, 1:54, 2:79, 3:11, 4:7 (151 patients with events).
- Key predictor: n_ongoing = integer count of MHONGO=="Yes" rows per patient (0–7; dist 0:482, 1:265, 2:151, 3:74, 4:22, 5:4, 6:1, 7:1).
- Controls: BCG (TRTGRP=="BCG"), work_hours {1,2,3}, patients_seen {1,2,3}, expect_interact {Yes=1}.
- Effect: **n_ongoing β = 0.2829 (SE 0.0726, z = 3.90, p = 0.0001); OR = exp(β) = 1.327; percentage increase in odds = (OR−1)×100 = 32.7% (95% CI 15.1–53.0%)**. Bootstrap (500 resamples): median 32.7% [15.8, 54.0]%.
- **Sign convention verified**: statsmodels OrderedModel parameterizes P(Y≤j)=F(θ_j − xβ); predicted cumulative probabilities for a median-control patient drop from P(Y≤0)=0.894 at n=0 to 0.783 at n=3 (all levels shift toward higher severity), confirming positive β ⇒ higher severity.
- Controls: patients_seen 83.4% (p=0.0001), expect_interact 18.7% (p=0.37), BCG 8.2% (p=0.66), work_hours 7.2% (p=0.71) — only patients_seen is significant besides n_ongoing.

Sensitivity matrix (percentage increase in odds of higher severity, all logit unless noted):
- All-AE worst grade (0–4, any AE): **47.3%** [31.8, 64.7] (lead sensitivity)
- COVID severity, cases only (n=151, levels 1–4): 24.8% [−7.7, 68.9] (unreliable — wide CI, sparse upper levels)
- All-AE severity, cases only (n=791): 40.1% [23.4, 59.2]
- Dummy-coded interaction controls: 32.2% [14.6, 52.5]
- + demographics (SEX, Age, education, RACE): 20.5% [3.1, 40.8]
- Cumulative-probit link: β=0.171 (same direction; exponentiated value not an odds ratio)
- Unadjusted: COVID 30.7%, all-AE 43.1%

Diagnostics: proportional-odds (Brant-style) check shows the n_ongoing effect is **stronger at severe cut-points** — separate-binary-logit coefficients per cutpoint Y>0: 0.11 (p=0.11), Y>1: 0.08 (p=0.37), Y>2: 0.44 (p=0.004), Y>3: 0.57 (p=0.017) — indicating partial PO violation; the pooled ordinal estimate (OR≈1.33) may understate the effect on severe disease. The 143 all-NaN AE rows (ID-only artifacts) were dropped; 66 patients with real AEs but all-missing AESEV were treated as severity 0 in the primary analysis.

**Answer: approximately 33% (0.327 × 100), i.e., each additional ongoing medical condition increases the odds of higher COVID-19 severity by about 32.7% (95% CI 15%–53%), after controlling for BCG status and patient-interaction variables.**
